title: Circuit Challenge
description: Versatile 3-round circuit mixing strength, cardio and core for a complete workout

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Jog in place, heels kicking toward glutes

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot side to side

exercises.name: Paused lunges
exercises.instructions: Lower and hold 3s at the bottom before standing

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands together under the chest, elbows close to the body

exercises.name: No-push-up burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm and leg alternating

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide, toes pointed out

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
